title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: Cross-validation helps in selecting the best hyperparameter by evaluating the model's performance on different subsets of the data. Look at the errors for each lambda value across the folds.

title: Analyzing Errors
text: Compare the errors for each lambda value across the folds. The goal is to choose the lambda that minimizes the error consistently.

title: Choosing the Best Lambda
text: Which lambda value has the lowest total error across both folds?
